facts.business: The company manufactures alloy and stainless steel castings for turbines, metal shredding, earth moving and mining equipment, power plants, pumps, valves, compressors, and other heavy engineering industries, and is also engaged in real estate business including leasing, purchase, sale, construction and development of buildings/properties.
